spans.s: Bindusaras. § 263 (Sabhākriyāp.): II, 3, 60, 62, 67.-§ 294 (Dyūtap.): II, 50, 1809 (the palace of Yudhishṭhira is kṛtāṃ Bindusaro-ratnaiḥ).--§ 423 (Gandhamādanap.): III, 145, 11057 (śivaṃ).--§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 6, 238: There king Bhagīratha, beholding Gaṅgā, resided for many years: there innumerable sacrificial stakes made of gems and chaitya trees made of gold may be seen. There Indra (Sahasrāksha) reached perfection (gataḥ siddhiṃ) by sacrificing; there Śiva (?Bhūtapatiḥ), etc. (), reside; there Gaṅgā, issuing from Brahmaloka, first showed herself, and then divided herself into seven streams: Vasvaukasārā, etc. ().
